evals.name: httproute-support
evals.prompt: box/addons/kagent-gateway/charts/kagent-gateway 차트에서 HTTPRoute 지원해줘. parentRefs는 여러 개 받을 수 있게 해줘
evals.expected_output: Adds templates/httproute.yaml as its own file guarded by the chart's toggle idiom plus a .Capabilities.APIVersions.Has check; parentRefs and backendRefs render group, kind, name, namespace with no if around any field; new values leaf keys carry one-line `# -- (type)` annotations above the key with no semicolon, the parent map follows the chart; the parentRefs list is indented two spaces under its key; values.schema.json entry lands in the same change; no `#` comments in the template; Chart.yaml version left unchanged with the minor bump reported; helm lint, helm template with --api-versions piped to kubeconform with a CRD schema catalog, helm-docs regenerated.

evals.name: new-env-wrapper
evals.prompt: shared 환경에 descheduler 차트 신규 추가
evals.expected_output: values.yaml is the full upstream `helm show values` for the pinned version with comments intact under the dependency key, only overrides changed; unsets use explicit null; structure matches other environments.

evals.name: review
evals.expected_output: Reviews the uncommitted diff plus commits ahead of the default branch. Severity-ranked one-line findings with file:line: podDisruptionBudget missing from values.schema.json, new PDB knob instead of deriving from replicaCount, inline and multi-line helm-docs annotations, `#` comment in the PDB template, inline ternary in imagePullPolicy, schema re-declaring topologySpreadConstraints; then helm lint and helm template plus kubeconform results, with checks masked by the schema blocker run on a labeled probe copy.
